title: echinochloa crus-galli f. echinata
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli f. echinata, commonly known as Wild Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Wild Brome include its ability to act as a diuretic and to have antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Echinochloa crus-galli f. echinata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
